name: cfcmt-bus-iql-actor-continuation-v1

evaluation.test_separation: Predefined before new training or evaluation; disjoint from fit/stop/calibration, smoke and all previous evaluation cohorts. Same pinned services and generated OD intensities.
evaluation.comparison: 48 actual new evaluations: new IQL actor18, previous SAC18, adapted55k9, rule3.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

checkpoint_rule: New IQL-actor and previous projected SAC controllers use fixed final20k continuation artifacts, with no outcome-based seed/checkpoint selection. Adapted55k is a fewer-update stage reference.
intervention: Only the actor loss changes from SAC min-Q plus latent entropy to the existing recorded-action IQL weighted likelihood. Preserve execution-projected generated actions, real/model critic losses, value updates, H2O+ backup, temperature updates, sampling order and replay.
boundary: Matched20k actor-objective intervention within an offline continuation. Hybrid recorded-action IQL actor with original SAC/H2O+ critic and temperature, not pure IQL, live LF interaction, or isolated normalized-confidence efficacy.
limits: One target city, fixed service date, generated OD destinations/intensities and three prospective passenger realizations.
Recorded-action likelihood constrains the loss; it is not a hard bound on actor actions or a correction of critic bias.
Execution projection preserves latent rather than executed-action entropy; temperature algorithm is unchanged, but its trajectory can change.
Adapted55k has fewer updates; model0/0.25 does not isolate normalized confidence from other model components.
All fixed seeds and final artifacts retained; no threshold, model, city, seed, checkpoint or temperature selection after outcomes.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen runtime and inputs only; no mutable Thesis access; no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
fixed_training: Each new arm loads the same seed-matched full-source50k plus target5k adapted learner and optimizers. 20k online=True continuation updates use original fit12288 only; existing V update and its detached IQL weights are reused. Model TD coefficients0/0.25, world model, normalized QDelta trust, generation, backup, alpha update, and RNG offsets unchanged. No training simulator interactions.
entropy_interpretation: Entropy/log probabilities remain those of the latent desired-action distribution. Many-to-one projection does not produce an execution-action density. Keep the frozen entropy kernel and temperature; ordinary clamp gradient is1 inside the interval and0 when saturated.
admission: Seed75101, four paired real/model steps per original-SAC/new-IQL-actor arm. Same replay draws, original IQL weights/labels, pre-actor critic/model computation and initial RNG/alpha; same V/critic/actor/temperature update counts and algorithms.
reporting_interpretation: 48 actual evaluations on prospective demand72531-72533 and SUMO73531-73533: new actor two arms18, previous SAC two arms18, adapted55k9, rule3. Same-demand comparison, equal seed/case weights, all outcomes, no old-case pooling or population CI.
actor_objective: Existing _update_iql_actor: negative mean detached IQL weight times raw recorded-action log likelihood; advantage temperature3 and max weight100. No extra coefficient, replay sampling, label projection, hard data-support bound or new V update.
temperature_interpretation: The SAC latent-temperature sample retains its original pre-actor-step position and random draws; alpha optimizer updates remain after the actor step. Alpha trajectories may diverge as actors diverge; no freeze, clamp or retuning.
